summary: Manual Automation Hub proof-of-life run. Tier B Pattern B was used: current evidence and state were preserved because a complete fresh observation could not be validated. Nasdaq's GME page returned data unavailable, the Cboe delayed-options JSON could not be retrieved in this runtime, and the GameStop newsroom page did not expose a readable release list. FINRA confirms September 24 as the publication date for the September 15 short-interest reporting date, but no new GME short-interest value was verified. This health-only update intentionally tests canonical GitHub-to-Site propagation without deployment.
